LESSON: NAME OF GOD

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.4: Name of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Name of God. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Name of God
2. Practise Name of God at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Name of God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Name of God
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Name of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Name of God at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Name of God at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Name of God
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Name of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Name of God using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Name of God in the examples.
2. Explain Name of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Name of God.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Name of God using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Name of God important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
